sloka: सुदृष्टां कुरु किष्किन्धां कुरुष्वात्मसमं पुरे ।क्रीडस्व च सह स्त्रीभिरहं ते दर्पनाशनः ॥४-११-३५॥।।
transliteration: sudṛṣṭāṁ kuru kiṣkindhāṁ kuruṣvātmasamaṁ pure ।krīḍasva ca saha strībhirahaṁ te darpanāśanaḥ ॥4-11-35॥।।

translations.english: 'Have a good look a Kishkinda. Assign some one like you kingship. Sport freely with women and come, I shall destroy your arrogance.
